# Calcotia

> Free online calculators for sick pay, holiday pay, severance, pensions and benefits in 28 countries, each in the local language with official formulas. Every calculator is free, with no account and no sign up, and every calculation runs in the visitor's own browser.

## Countries

- [Norway calculators](https://calcotia.online/no/): sick pay, holiday pay, parental benefits, parental leave planner and unemployment benefit (dagpenger), plus 46 new calculators: health (BMI, promille, HbA1c, calories, pregnancy, max heart rate, body fat percentage, menstruation), finance (VAT, wealth tax, mortgage, consumer loan, tax table, fund returns, student loan, CPI, car loan, pension saving, property tax, IBAN, refinancing, credit card, BSU, Norgespris, electricity support, equity, IPS, currency, gold price, study points, rent), work and NAV (dagpenger 2026, disability benefit, child support, hourly wage, mileage allowance, travel deduction, company car, AAP, layoff, cash benefit) and other (tyres, speeding fines, grade average, bra size, fuel)
- [Germany calculators](https://calcotia.online/de/): citizen's income (Bürgergeld), top-up (Aufstockung), gross to net salary (Brutto Netto) and working student net pay (Werkstudent)
- [France calculators](https://calcotia.online/fr/): parental, maternity and paternity leave
- [Italy calculators](https://calcotia.online/it/): severance pay, parental leave and unemployment benefit
- [Japan calculators](https://calcotia.online/jp/): retirement money tax and take-home pay
- [Greece calculators](https://calcotia.online/gr/): dismissal compensation
- [Israel calculators](https://calcotia.online/il/): recuperation pay
- [Vietnam calculators](https://calcotia.online/vn/): one-time social insurance payout
- [Slovakia calculators](https://calcotia.online/sk/): state pension estimate and retirement age by birth year
- [Serbia calculators](https://calcotia.online/rs/): child allowance eligibility and amount
- [Saudi Arabia calculators](https://calcotia.online/sa/): end of service benefits in Arabic and English
- [Sweden calculators](https://calcotia.online/se/): holiday pay compensation (semesterersättning)
- [Ireland calculators](https://calcotia.online/ie/): holiday pay (annual leave and public holidays)
- [Iceland calculators](https://calcotia.online/is/): holiday pay (orlof)
- [Taiwan calculators](https://calcotia.online/tw/): severance pay (new and old system)
- [Spain calculators](https://calcotia.online/es/): severance pay (despido objetivo, improcedente, temporal and transitional regime), severance pay in English and finiquito in Spanish, plus 15 new calculators: health and sport (percentiles, steps to km, running pace), finance (IVA e IRPF, TAE, IBAN), payroll (net salary, sick leave, extra pay, reduced hours), legal (legal interest) and maths (quadratic equations, inverse matrix, slope, divisions)
- [United Arab Emirates calculators](https://calcotia.online/ae/): end of service gratuity (Article 51)
- [Philippines calculators](https://calcotia.online/ph/): 13th month pay (PD 851)
- [Netherlands calculators](https://calcotia.online/nl/): holiday allowance (vakantiegeld, 8% of gross salary), plus 73 new calculators: health (14: BMI, calories, macros, child height, ovulation, sleep, body fat, 1RM, running pace, heart rate zones, alcohol, VO2max, pregnancy, child BMI), finance (19: gross to net, VAT, mortgage, compound interest, currency, returns, self-employed tax, inflation, loan, fuel costs, pension, shares, discount, tip, net worth, gold price, leasing, rent, IBAN), work and law (6: company car tax, travel costs, student loan, collection costs, hours, holidays), construction (10: concrete, paint, laminate, wallpaper, stairs, curtains, levelling compound, cable size, radiator, degree days), maths (9: circle, grade average, percentages, Pythagoras, triangle, fractions, cylinder, tangent, proportions) and other (15: age, date, kitchen measures, tyre size, energy use, dog age, cat age, snowboard length, solar panels, Ohm's law, love, week number, bra size, subnet, time)
- [Romania calculators](https://calcotia.online/ro/): overtime pay (ore suplimentare, 75% premium, night premium and holiday premium under the Labour Code) and net salary (salariu net, CAS, CASS, tax and personal deduction under the Fiscal Code), plus 49 new calculators: health (7: BMI, calories, pregnancy, blood alcohol, ovulation, menstruation, blood pressure), finance (8: VAT, credit, compound interest, car tax, car leasing, early repayment, dividends, rental income tax), work and pay (5: length of service, PFA taxes, unemployment benefit, child-raising allowance, sick leave), legal (4: stamp duty, legal interest, court deadlines, alimony) and maths and more (25: deposit interest, percentages, average, days between dates, fuel consumption, discount, square metres, rule of three, GCD and LCM, hours, kW to HP, pension, holiday leave, energy bill, scientific, roots, age, cable section, concrete, roof, timber, pig farrowing, pig weight, destiny number, wedding gift)
- [Mexico calculators](https://calcotia.online/mx/): final settlement (finiquito) under the Federal Labour Law, in English and Spanish
- [Chile calculators](https://calcotia.online/cl/): severance pay (finiquito) under the Labour Code, in English and Spanish
- [Czechia calculators](https://calcotia.online/cz/): severance pay (odstupné) under § 67 of the Labour Code, plus 95 new calculators: health (BMI, BMI for children, body surface area, blood alcohol, BMR, water intake, hCG, ideal weight, waist circumference, kidney function (eGFR), calories burned, body fat, running pace, bra size, heart rate zones, calories, vaccination, ovulation, sleep, TDEE, pregnancy, WHR), finance (income tax, mortgage, insolvency, investments, bonds, VAT, inflation, percentages, APR (RPSN), compound interest, savings, gold price, exchange rate, loans), work (pension, travel allowances, net salary, holiday, sick pay, severance pay, work experience, early retirement, overtime, average hourly earnings, alimony), maths (derivatives, integrals, logarithms, scale, powers, GCD and LCM, LCM, volume, circle circumference, square roots, area, unit conversion, average, equations, speed, systems of equations, rule of three, triangles, weighted average, fractions, matrices, Pythagoras), construction (anhydrite floors, paint, concrete, tiles, mortar, flooring, stairs, fuel consumption, roofs, wallpaper, heat loss), date and time (date, time, days, months, working days, age) and other (BARF for dogs, IQ, beer carbonation, pizza, electricity consumption, dog age, zodiac signs, calories in beer, numerology)

- [Thailand calculators](https://calcotia.online/th/): severance pay (ค่าชดเชย) under Section 118 of the Labour Protection Act
- [South Korea calculators](https://calcotia.online/kr/): severance pay under the Labour Standards Act, in English
- [Poland calculators](https://calcotia.online/pl/): severance pay (odprawa pieniężna) under the Labour Code, plus 243 new calculators: health (52: liver enzymes ALT/AST, cholesterol, blood pressure, HbA1c, TDEE and BMR, calories, pregnancy weeks, steps, vitamins, body fat, heart rate zones, baby weight, sleep, VO2max, WHR, BSA, FFMI), finance (45: B2B net income, mortgage, PIT annual return, VAT, excise duty, stock market, bonds, BIK score, rent, property tax, leasing, donations, subsidies, gold price, exchange rates, notarial fees), maths (44: percentages, fractions, matrices, quadratic equations, powers, roots, trigonometry, averages, unit conversion, temperature, areas and volumes, Roman numerals, fuel consumption), work and law (23: overtime, leave, notice period, alimony, sick benefit, maternity leave, mileage allowance, employer costs, 13th salary, PFRON, teachers’ workload, severance pay), construction (33: paint, concrete, insulation thickness, photovoltaics, fencing, roofing, tiles, wallpaper, steel profiles, screed, coal, epoxy resin), dates and time (5: age, working days, months, minutes, years), physics (2: force and speed) and other (39: PESEL, Lotto and Keno odds, dog food (BARF), alcohol dilution, taxi fares, numerology, zodiac sign, beer for a wedding, pickling, subnet calculator, dog years)
